property_summary: For any recipient who cannot receive ETH (a reverting/payable-rejecting recipient), calling getFirstWithdrawalBonus(recipient) on the reference contract must not leave any reward balance stored for that recipient (the reference will attempt withdrawal and revert the whole call, so the call reverts), whereas the mutant that removes the withdraw will succeed and leave rewardsForA[recipient] > 0 — so the property: calling getFirstWithdrawalBonus on a recipient whose fallback reverts always reverts on the reference but may succeed on the mutant.
change_summary: Remove the call to withdrawReward and instead mark bonus claimed and leave funds in rewardsForA (so no immediate withdrawal occurs).
